verses.original: כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּן וּרְבִיתֶ֗ם וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ham·miṣ·wāh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm tiš·mə·rūn la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lə·ma·‘an tiḥ·yūn ū·rə·ḇî·ṯem ū·ḇā·ṯem wî·riš·tem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today so that you may live and multiply and enter and possess the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers
verses.literalPt: TODOS os mandamentos que hoje vos ordeno guardareis para os cumprir; para que vivais, e vos multipliqueis, e entreis, e possuais a terra que o SENHOR jurou a vossos pais.

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתָּ֣ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֹלִֽיכֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ זֶ֛ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְמַ֨עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֜ לְנַסֹּֽתְךָ֗ לָדַ֜עַת אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֧ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֛ הֲתִשְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֹתוֹ אִם־ לֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tā ’eṯ- kāl- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer hō·lî·ḵă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā zeh ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh bam·miḏ·bār lə·ma·‘an ‘an·nō·ṯə·ḵā lə·nas·sō·ṯə·ḵā lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ’eṯ- ’ă·šer bil·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā hă·ṯiš·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯō ’im- lō
verses.literal: Remember that these forty years the LORD your God led you all the way in the wilderness so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart whether or not you would keep His commandments
verses.literalPt: E te lembrarás de todo o caminho, pelo qual o SENHOR teu Deus te guiou no deserto estes quarenta anos, para te humilhar, e te provar, para saber o que estava no teu coração, se guardarias os seus mandamentos, ou não.

verses.original: וַֽיְעַנְּךָ֮ וַיַּרְעִבֶךָ֒ וַיַּֽאֲכִֽלְךָ֤ אֶת הַמָּן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ יָדַ֔עְתָּ וְלֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן הוֹדִֽעֲךָ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל־ הַלֶּ֤חֶם לְבַדּוֹ֙ יִחְיֶ֣ה הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֛י עַל־ כָּל־ מוֹצָ֥א פִֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה יִחְיֶ֥ה הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·‘an·nə·ḵā way·yar·‘i·ḇe·ḵā way·ya·’ă·ḵil·ḵā ʾɛṯ ham·mān ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏa‘·tā wə·lō yā·ḏə·‘ūn ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lə·ma·‘an hō·w·ḏi·‘ă·ḵā kî lō ‘al- hal·le·ḥem lə·ḇad·dōw yiḥ·yeh hā·’ā·ḏām kî ‘al- kāl- mō·w·ṣā p̄î- Yah·weh yiḥ·yeh hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: He humbled you and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat which neither you nor your fathers had known so that . . . you might understand that man does not live on bread alone but - on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E te humilhou, e te deixou ter fome, e te sustentou com o maná, que tu não conheceste, nem teus pais o conheceram; para te dar a entender que o homem não viverá só de pão, mas de tudo o que sai da boca do SENHOR viverá o homem.

verses.original: שִׂמְלָ֨תְךָ֜ לֹ֤א בָֽלְתָה֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְרַגְלְךָ֖ לֹ֣א בָצֵ֑קָה זֶ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: śim·lā·ṯə·ḵā lō ḇā·lə·ṯāh mê·‘ā·le·ḵā wə·raḡ·lə·ḵā lō ḇā·ṣê·qāh zeh ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh
verses.literal: Your clothing did not wear out . . . and your feet did not swell during these forty years
verses.literalPt: Nunca se envelheceu a tua roupa sobre ti, nem se inchou o teu pé nestes quarenta anos.

verses.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ עִם־ לְבָבֶ֑ךָ כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְיַסֵּ֥ר אִישׁ֙ אֶת־ בְּנ֔וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מְיַסְּרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā kî ka·’ă·šer yə·yas·sêr ’îš ’eṯ- bə·nōw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mə·yas·sə·re·kā
verses.literal: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son so the LORD your God disciplines you
verses.literalPt: Sabes, pois, no teu coração que, como um homem castiga a seu filho, assim te castiga o SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣מַרְתָּ֔ אֶת־ מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לָלֶ֥כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֖יו וּלְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mar·tā ’eṯ- miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lā·le·ḵeṯ biḏ·rā·ḵāw ū·lə·yir·’āh ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God walking in His ways and fearing Him
verses.literalPt: E guarda os mandamentos do SENHOR teu Deus, para andares nos seus caminhos e para o temeres.

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מְבִֽיאֲךָ֖ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ טוֹבָ֑ה אֶ֚רֶץ נַ֣חֲלֵי מָ֔יִם עֲיָנֹת֙ וּתְהֹמֹ֔ת יֹצְאִ֥ים בַּבִּקְעָ֖ה וּבָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mə·ḇî·’ă·ḵā ’el- ’e·reṣ ṭō·w·ḇāh ’e·reṣ na·ḥă·lê mā·yim ‘ă·yā·nōṯ ū·ṯə·hō·mōṯ yō·ṣə·’îm bab·biq·‘āh ū·ḇā·hār
verses.literal: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land a land of brooks . . . and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills
verses.literalPt: Porque o SENHOR teu Deus te põe numa boa terra, terra de ribeiros de águas, de fontes, e de mananciais, que saem dos vales e das montanhas;

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ חִטָּה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֔ה וְגֶ֥פֶן וּתְאֵנָ֖ה וְרִמּ֑וֹן אֶֽרֶץ־ זֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶן וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ ḥiṭ·ṭāh ū·śə·‘ō·rāh wə·ḡe·p̄en ū·ṯə·’ê·nāh wə·rim·mō·wn ’e·reṣ- zêṯ še·men ū·ḏə·ḇāš
verses.literal: a land of wheat barley vines fig trees and pomegranates a land of olive oil and honey
verses.literalPt: Terra de trigo e cevada, e de vides e figueiras, e romeiras; terra de oliveiras, de azeite e mel.

verses.original: אֶ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹ֤א בְמִסְכֵּנֻת֙ תֹּֽאכַל־ בָּ֣הּ לֶ֔חֶם לֹֽא־ תֶחְסַ֥ר כֹּ֖ל בָּ֑הּ אֶ֚רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲבָנֶ֣יהָ בַרְזֶ֔ל וּמֵהֲרָרֶ֖יהָ תַּחְצֹ֥ב נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ ’ă·šer lō ḇə·mis·kê·nuṯ tō·ḵal- bāh le·ḥem lō- ṯeḥ·sar kōl bāh ’e·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ă·ḇā·ne·hā ḇar·zel ū·mê·hă·rā·re·hā taḥ·ṣōḇ nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: a land where you will eat food without scarcity where you will lack nothing . . . a land whose rocks are iron and whose hills are ready to be mined for copper
verses.literalPt: Terra em que comerás o pão sem escassez, e nada te faltará nela; terra cujas pedras são ferro, e de cujos montes tu cavarás o cobre.

verses.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבֵֽרַכְתָּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḵal·tā wə·śā·ḇā·‘ə·tā ū·ḇê·raḵ·tā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ haṭ·ṭō·ḇāh ’ă·šer nā·ṯan- lāḵ
verses.literal: When you eat and are satisfied you are to bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, tiveres comido, e fores farto, louvarás ao SENHOR teu Deus pela boa terra que te deu.

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־ תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְבִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: hiš·šā·mer lə·ḵā pen- tiš·kaḥ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lə·ḇil·tî šə·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯāw ū·miš·pā·ṭāw wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Be careful not to forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes which I am giving you this day
verses.literalPt: Guarda-te que não te esqueças do SENHOR teu Deus, deixando de guardar os seus mandamentos, e os seus juízos, e os seus estatutos que hoje te ordeno;

verses.original: פֶּן־ תֹּאכַ֖ל וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבָתִּ֥ים טוֹבִ֛ים תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְיָשָֽׁבְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: pen- tō·ḵal wə·śā·ḇā·‘ə·tā ū·ḇāt·tîm ṭō·w·ḇîm tiḇ·neh wə·yā·šā·ḇə·tā
verses.literal: Otherwise when you eat and are satisfied when you build fine houses in which to dwell
verses.literalPt: Para não suceder que, havendo tu comido e fores farto, e havendo edificado boas casas, e habitando-as,

verses.original: וּבְקָֽרְךָ֤ וְצֹֽאנְךָ֙ יִרְבְּיֻ֔ן וְכֶ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב יִרְבֶּה־ לָּ֑ךְ וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ לְךָ֖ יִרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·qā·rə·ḵā wə·ṣō·nə·ḵā yir·bə·yun wə·ḵe·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ yir·beh- lāḵ wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- lə·ḵā yir·beh
verses.literal: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all that you have is multiplied
verses.literalPt: E se tiverem aumentado os teus gados e os teus rebanhos, e se acrescentar a prata e o ouro, e se multiplicar tudo quanto tens,

verses.original: וְרָ֖ם לְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְשָֽׁכַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rām lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā wə·šā·ḵaḥ·tā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ham·mō·w·ṣî·’ă·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mib·bêṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm
verses.literal: then your heart will become proud and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt out of the house of slavery
verses.literalPt: Se eleve o teu coração e te esqueças do SENHOR teu Deus, que te tirou da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão;

verses.original: הַמּוֹלִ֨יכֲךָ֜ בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר׀ הַגָּדֹ֣ל וְהַנּוֹרָ֗א נָחָ֤שׁ׀ שָׂרָף֙ וְעַקְרָ֔ב וְצִמָּא֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין־ מָ֑יִם הַמּוֹצִ֤יא לְךָ֙ מַ֔יִם מִצּ֖וּר הַֽחַלָּמִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mō·w·lî·ḵă·ḵā bam·miḏ·bār hag·gā·ḏōl wə·han·nō·w·rā nā·ḥāš śā·rāp̄ wə·‘aq·rāḇ wə·ṣim·mā·’ō·wn ’ă·šer ’ên- mā·yim ham·mō·w·ṣî lə·ḵā ma·yim miṣ·ṣūr ha·ḥal·lā·mîš
verses.literal: He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions a thirsty and waterless land He brought you water from the rock of flint
verses.literalPt: Que te guiou por aquele grande e terrível deserto de serpentes ardentes, e de escorpiões, e de terra seca, em que não havia água; e tirou água para ti da rocha pederneira;

verses.original: הַמַּֽאֲכִ֨לְךָ֥ מָן֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֗ וּלְמַ֙עַן֙ נַסֹּתֶ֔ךָ לְהֵיטִֽבְךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·ma·’ă·ḵil·ḵā mān bam·miḏ·bār ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏə·‘ūn ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lə·ma·‘an ‘an·nō·ṯə·ḵā ū·lə·ma·‘an nas·sō·ṯe·ḵā lə·hê·ṭiḇ·ḵā bə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known in order to humble you . . . and test you so that in the end He might cause you to prosper
verses.literalPt: Que no deserto te sustentou com maná, que teus pais não conheceram; para te humilhar, e para te provar, para no fim te fazer bem;

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ כֹּחִי֙ וְעֹ֣צֶם יָדִ֔י עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖י אֶת־ הַחַ֥יִל הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā bil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā kō·ḥî wə·‘ō·ṣem yā·ḏî ‘ā·śāh lî ’eṯ- ha·ḥa·yil haz·zeh
verses.literal: You might say in your heart The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me
verses.literalPt: E digas no teu coração: A minha força, e a fortaleza da minha mão, me adquiriu este poder.

verses.original: וְזָֽכַרְתָּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כִּ֣י ה֗וּא הַנֹּתֵ֥ן לְךָ֛ כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת חָ֑יִל לְמַ֨עַן הָקִ֧ים אֶת־ בְּרִית֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā kî hū han·nō·ṯên lə·ḵā kō·aḥ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ḥā·yil lə·ma·‘an hā·qîm ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯōw ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘ la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā kay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: But remember that it is the LORD your God . . . who gives you the power to gain wealth in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day
verses.literalPt: Antes te lembrarás do SENHOR teu Deus, que ele é o que te dá força para adquirires riqueza; para confirmar a sua aliança, que jurou a teus pais, como se vê neste dia.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ שָׁכֹ֤חַ תִּשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָֽלַכְתָּ֗ אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַעֲבַדְתָּ֖ם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם הַעִדֹ֤תִי בָכֶם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵדֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- šā·ḵō·aḥ tiš·kaḥ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·hā·laḵ·tā ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tām wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wî·ṯā lā·hem ha·‘i·ḏō·ṯî ḇā·ḵem hay·yō·wm kî ’ā·ḇōḏ tō·ḇê·ḏūn
verses.literal: If you ever forget . . . the LORD your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them I testify against you today that you will surely perish . . .
verses.literalPt: Será, porém, que, se de qualquer modo te esqueceres do SENHOR teu Deus, e se ouvires outros deuses, e os servires, e te inclinares perante eles, hoje eu testifico contra vós que certamente perecereis.

verses.original: כַּגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְהוָה֙ מַאֲבִ֣יד מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם כֵּ֖ן תֹאבֵד֑וּן עֵ֚קֶב לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֔וּן בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: kag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer Yah·weh ma·’ă·ḇîḏ mip·pə·nê·ḵem kên ṯō·ḇê·ḏūn ‘ê·qeḇ lō ṯiš·mə·‘ūn bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Like the nations that the LORD has destroyed before you so you will perish . . . if you do not obey . . . the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Como as nações que o SENHOR destruiu diante de vós, assim vós perecereis, porquanto não queríeis obedecer à voz do SENHOR vosso Deus.
